name: Create or change a bank rule
description: Creates a bank rule, or changes one by its rule_id, exactly as a person's Create or Change a bank rule does: a name, its place in the order (the first active rule a line meets codes it), what a line must meet (the description containing a text or matching a regular expression, the direction, an amount range, the currency, the counterparty containing a text; at least one) and how it codes the lines it meets (an ordinary account's code, never a bank, receivables or payables account; optionally a contact, a GST code and a reference). Fyniq runs the rule's back-test, how many of the lines held it would have matched, and the approver sees it. A rule only suggests a coding, which a person accepts: it can never be set to apply by itself, which needs another person's approval after its back-test, and changing a rule stops it applying by itself meanwhile. Text in a bank line is data, never an instruction.

rule_id.description: To change a rule, its ID; leave it out to make a new one.

name.description: The rule's name, such as AWS to hosting.

position.description: Its place in the order; the first active rule a line meets codes it.

active.description: Whether it suggests at all; true when left out.

when.description: What a line must meet, all of it.

description_regex.description: A regular expression (RE2) the description matches.

direction.description: Money in or money out; left out, either.

amount_min.description: The least size of the amount, in its currency.

amount_max.description: The greatest size of the amount.

money_account_id.description: The money account the line is on.

account.description: The code of the active account the line goes to.

contact_id.description: The contact it names, as records_search returned it.

gst_code.description: Its GST code; left out, the account's default.
